Home.title: submitnow
Home.description: Submit URLs to Bing via IndexNow. Your site must host the key file and the submitted URLs must match the same host.

highlights.speedDescription: Send up to 10,000 URLs with a single batch call.
highlights.verificationDescription: Host the key file on your domain to prove ownership.
highlights.reachDescription: One submission notifies Bing and IndexNow partners.

IndexNow.title: Submit URLs to Bing
IndexNow.description: Send a batch request to the Bing IndexNow endpoint.
IndexNow.bingOnlyNote: Submission endpoint: Bing (shared with IndexNow partners).
IndexNow.supportedEnginesNote: One submission reaches all participating search engines.
IndexNow.urlsHelp: One URL per line (or separated by spaces/commas). All URLs must belong to the same host. Maximum 10,000 URLs per request.
IndexNow.keyHelp: Your key must match the key file content hosted on your site (KEY.txt).
IndexNow.hostHelp: If omitted, the host will be inferred from the URL list.
IndexNow.keyLocationHelp: If omitted, it will be set to https://{host}/{key}.txt. The hostname must match the submitted URLs.

errors.invalid_form: Please check the form fields and try again.
errors.invalid_key: Invalid key. Use 8–128 characters (letters, numbers, dashes).
errors.invalid_host: Invalid host. Please enter a domain like example.com.
errors.invalid_key_location: Invalid key file URL. The hostname must match the submitted host.
errors.invalid_urls: Invalid URLs. Please provide valid http(s) URLs.
errors.mixed_hosts: URLs contain multiple hosts. Please submit one host per request.
errors.host_mismatch: Host does not match the URL host. Please leave it empty or match the URLs.
errors.too_many_urls: Too many URLs. Maximum is 10,000 per request.
errors.bing_invalid_request: Bing rejected the request (HTTP {status}). Please check your host, key, and URL list.
errors.bing_invalid_key: Bing rejected the key (HTTP {status}). Ensure your key file is accessible and matches the key.
errors.bing_invalid_url_list: Bing rejected the URL list (HTTP {status}). Ensure URLs are valid and belong to the host.
errors.bing_rate_limited: Rate limited by Bing (HTTP {status}). Please retry later.
errors.bing_error: Bing IndexNow request failed (HTTP {status}). Please verify your key and URL list.
errors.timeout: Request timed out. Please try again.

Tools.title: Prepare publish-ready URLs before you submit
Tools.description: Small, focused utilities for creating a key, cleaning a URL batch, and finding sitemap changes. Your files and inputs stay in this browser session.

preview.title: Build a cleaner IndexNow workflow
preview.description: Generate a key, prepare a single-host batch, and isolate sitemap changes before you notify search engines.

principles.local: Inputs are processed in your browser and are never stored by submitnow.
principles.review: Review duplicate, invalid, and mixed-host URLs before submitting.
principles.export: Copy or download a clean queue when you are ready to submit.

common.localOnly: This tool runs in your browser. It does not create an account, store your input, or fetch a remote site on your behalf.

keyGenerator.title: IndexNow Key Generator
keyGenerator.description: Create a strong key locally and download the text file needed for ownership verification.
keyGenerator.shortDescription: Generate and download a key file locally.

batchBuilder.title: IndexNow Batch Builder
batchBuilder.description: Clean a pasted URL list, remove duplicates, and split it into safe single-host submission groups.
batchBuilder.shortDescription: Clean URLs and group them by host.

sitemapDiff.title: Sitemap Diff
sitemapDiff.description: Compare two uploaded sitemap files locally and build a queue from new or changed URLs.
sitemapDiff.shortDescription: Find new and changed sitemap URLs.

keyGenerator.title: Generate an IndexNow key locally
keyGenerator.description: Create a high-entropy key in your browser, then download the matching text file without sending the key to submitnow.
keyGenerator.keyHelp: Generate a new key whenever you need one. Keep the key and its text file private until you deploy it on your site.
keyGenerator.copySuccess: The key has been copied to your clipboard.
keyGenerator.copyFailure: Unable to copy automatically. Select the key and copy it manually.
keyGenerator.stepsTitle: Use this key in three steps

steps.generateStep: Generate a key and download the matching .txt file.
steps.hostStep: Upload the file to your site, normally as https://your-host/your-key.txt.
steps.submitStep: Paste the same key into the IndexNow submission form with URLs from that host.

keyGenerator.rootFileNote: A root-level key file is the simplest option when you need to submit URLs from across your host.

batchBuilder.title: Clean a URL batch before IndexNow submission
batchBuilder.description: Paste or import a list of URLs to remove duplicates, identify invalid values, and separate URLs by hostname entirely in your browser.
batchBuilder.inputHelp: Use one URL per line, or separate URLs with spaces and commas. You can also import a plain-text or CSV file.
batchBuilder.importFailure: The selected file could not be read.
batchBuilder.singleHost: A single host can be copied directly into the submission form.
batchBuilder.multipleHosts: IndexNow submissions must use one host at a time. Copy each host group separately.
batchBuilder.tooManyUrls: This list has {count} valid URLs. IndexNow accepts at most 10,000 URLs in one request.
batchBuilder.groupsHelp: Each group contains URLs from one hostname. Copy only one group for each IndexNow request.
batchBuilder.emptyState: Paste or import URLs to create submission groups.
batchBuilder.moreUrls: {count, plural, one {+# more URL} other {+# more URLs}}
batchBuilder.invalidTitle: Some values are not valid http(s) URLs
batchBuilder.invalidHelp: Fix or remove these values before you create a submission batch.

sitemapDiff.title: Find sitemap changes without uploading them to a server
sitemapDiff.description: Upload an older and a newer sitemap XML file. The comparison runs locally and lets you export only added or changed URLs for an IndexNow queue.
sitemapDiff.previousHelp: Upload the earlier sitemap XML file to use as the baseline.
sitemapDiff.currentHelp: Upload the newer sitemap XML file that you want to compare.
sitemapDiff.entryCount: {count, plural, one {# valid URL found} other {# valid URLs found}}

errors.invalidXml: This file is not valid XML.
errors.emptyUrlset: This URL set does not contain any valid http(s) URLs.
errors.sitemapIndex: This is a sitemap index with {count} child sitemap URLs. To keep this tool browser-only, upload the individual sitemap XML files you want to compare.
errors.unsupported: This XML is not a sitemap URL set or sitemap index.
errors.invalidLocations: {count} invalid sitemap locations were excluded from the comparison.

sitemapDiff.resultsHelp: Select added and/or changed URLs, then copy or download the queue for the submission tool.
sitemapDiff.emptyState: Upload two valid sitemap URL sets to calculate changes.
sitemapDiff.includeAdded: Include {count, plural, one {# added URL} other {# added URLs}}
sitemapDiff.includeChanged: Include {count, plural, one {# changed URL} other {# changed URLs}}
sitemapDiff.copySuccess: The selected queue has been copied to your clipboard.
sitemapDiff.copyFailure: Unable to copy automatically. Download the queue instead.
sitemapDiff.moreUrls: {count, plural, one {+# more URL} other {+# more URLs}}
